title: 岬の灯台と、繕い直された夜
author: 白湯 ぬくみ

en.title: The Lighthouse on the Cape and the Night That Was Mended
en.premise: At the breezy tip of a sea‑scented cape, Tsumugi tends the lighthouse and runs a tiny mending shop. She carefully restores old clothes and tools that still hold their owners' memories, offering quiet comfort to every visitor. One lunar‑eclipse night, a traveler arrives bearing a faded piece of ancient cloth. That single fragment sets in motion a gentle tale of stitching together lost moments.

zh.title: 岬之灯塔与被修补的夜
zh.premise: 在海风拂面的岬角尽头，守护灯塔的守灯人和经营小小修补铺的女子——紬的故事。她细心修复承载主人记忆的旧衣旧物，温柔地贴近来访者的心。某次月食之夜，旅人带来一块褪色的古布。这块布开启了一段静静的物语，试图把失去的宝贵时光重新连结。
